question: A cyclotron facility produces a specific radioactive isotope at a steady, constant rate of exactly $10^6$ nuclei per second. The half-life of this isotope is very short, exactly $10 \text{ seconds}$. If the production process starts into an empty vial at $t=0$, what will be the recorded activity of the sample in the vial exactly $20 \text{ seconds}$ later?
